module_contract.safety: Do not monkeypatch runtime classes, change gates/constants/scene/camera mounts, or write live qpos/qvel/ctrl/forces. Only a separate MjData copy may be used for kinematics. End with the original full task success; no skipped source episodes or alternate initial states.

robot_kinematics_methods.name: S.robot.ik_local
robot_kinematics_methods.signature: def ik_local(self, hand, pos, rot, q_init, base_qpos, q_post, rot_weight=0.3, damping=0.02, null_gain=0.1, iters=12, max_iter_step=0.05, margin=LIMIT_MARGIN, tol_m=0.0001, tol_rad=0.001, null_mask=None, limit_zone=0.0, limit_gain=0.0)
robot_kinematics_methods.doc:
Local damped-least-squares IK from q_init (continuous: never jumps to another solution branch).
Each iteration: dq = J^T (J J^T + damping^2 I)^-1 e + null_gain * (I - J^+ J)(q_post - q), clipped to
max_iter_step and to the joint limits minus `margin`. Returns (q, pos_err_m, rot_err_deg).

critical_runtime_source.plan_line:
def plan_line(self, goals, speed=0.10, min_s=0.5, allow=None, start=None, check=True, label='line', soft=None):
        """Joint plans {hand: (n, 7)} for straight TCP lines to goals {hand: (pos, R)} from `start` joints (default: the
        commanded joints), executed together; raises PlanError. Nothing is executed. soft: {hand: world axis} about
        which that hand may turn (up to SOFT_TOL_DEG) to stay reachable."""
        start = start or {}
        q0 = {h: np.asarray(start.get(h, self.q_cmd(h)), float) for h in HANDS}
        n = 0
        starts = {}
        for h, (p, R) in goals.items():
            p0, R0 = self.fk(h, q0[h])
            starts[h] = (p0, R0)
            ang = Rotation.from_matrix(np.asarray(R) @ R0.T).magnitude()
            T = max(min_s, np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(p) - p0) / speed, ang / 0.6)
            n = max(n, int(np.ceil(T * FPS)))
        n_nominal = n
        for _ in range(4):
            if n > max(3 * n_nominal, n_nominal + 3 * FPS):
                raise PlanError(f'{label}: line would need {n / FPS:.1f} s (nominal {n_nominal / FPS:.1f} s): it passes '
                                'near a singularity or a joint limit')
            plans, worst_step = {}, 0.0
            for h, (p, R) in goals.items():
                p0, R0 = starts[h]
                s = _hc(n)
                slerp = Slerp([0, 1], Rotation.from_matrix([R0, np.asarray(R)]))
                q = q0[h].copy()
                post = q.copy()
                out = np.zeros((n, 7))
                for k in range(n):
                    pk = p0 + s[k] * (np.asarray(p) - p0)
                    Rk = slerp([s[k]]).as_matrix()[0]
                    if soft and h in soft:
                        qn, pe, re, about = self.ik_local_soft(h, pk, Rk, q, post, soft[h])
                        if pe > LINE_POS_TOL or re > IK_ROT_TOL or about > SOFT_TOL_DEG:
                            raise PlanError(f'{label}: {h} line leaves the reachable set at {k / n:.0%} '
                                            f'({pe * 1000:.1f} mm, {re:.1f} deg, {about:.0f} deg about the soft axis)')
                        worst_step = max(worst_step, float(np.abs(qn - q).max()))
                        out[k] = q = qn
                        continue
                    qn, pe, re = self.robot.ik_local(h, pk, Rk, q, self.d.qpos, post, iters=30)
                    if pe > LINE_POS_TOL or re > IK_ROT_TOL:
                        # near a joint limit the damped step stalls: bounded least squares from the same joints
                        qs, pe2, re2 = self.ik_solver.solve(h, pk, Rk, [q])
                        if pe2 <= LINE_POS_TOL and re2 <= IK_ROT_TOL and np.abs(qs - q).max() <= 4 * STEP_MAX:
                            qn, pe, re = qs, pe2, re2
                    if pe > LINE_POS_TOL or re > IK_ROT_TOL:
                        raise PlanError(f'{label}: {h} line leaves the reachable set at {k / n:.0%} '
                                        f'({pe * 1000:.1f} mm, {re:.1f} deg)')
                    worst_step = max(worst_step, float(np.abs(qn - q).max()))
                    out[k] = q = qn
                plans[h] = out
            if worst_step <= STEP_MAX:
                break
            n = int(np.ceil(n * worst_step / STEP_MAX * 1.1))
        if check:
            ok, info = self._path_ok(plans, allow, others={h: q0[h] for h in HANDS if h not in goals})
            if not ok:
                raise PlanError(f'{label}: line not clear: {info}')
        return plans

ROBOTIQ_XML = Path('third_party/mujoco_menagerie/robotiq_2f85/2f85.xml')
# Gripper mounting: GRIPPER_YAW / FACTORY_* above, per DuoPlacement. Wrist camera (RealSense D405, 1280x720, ~87 x 58
# deg): NOMINAL mount, 7.5 cm off the gripper axis on the gripper's +x side, 3 cm in front of the flange, aimed at the
# pinch point; the real holder pose is what the photographs are for.
WRIST_CAM_IN_GRIPPER = np.array([0.075, 0.0, 0.03])
D405_FOVY_DEG = 58.0
                            pos=[0, 0, h / 2], contype=0, conaffinity=0, group=2, rgba=[0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1])
        base = spec.body(f'{hand}_g_base')
        pinch = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.145])
        base.add_site(name=f'{hand}_tcp', pos=pinch)
        cam_pos = WRIST_CAM_IN_GRIPPER - np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0038])  # base frame is 3.8 mm past base_mount
        z = cam_pos - pinch  # camera looks along -z: from the camera toward the pinch point
        z /= np.linalg.norm(z)
        x = np.cross([0.0, 1.0, 0.0], z)
        x /= np.linalg.norm(x)
        cam = base.add_camera(name=f'{hand}_wrist', pos=cam_pos, fovy=D405_FOVY_DEG)
        cam.alt.type = mujoco.mjtOrientation.mjORIENTATION_XYAXES
        cam.alt.xyaxes = list(np.r_[x, np.cross(z, x)])
